scientific_integrity: Original primary-source authors are credited. The proof is analytic; symbolic and numerical checks independently recompute finite formulas and provide diagnostics rather than independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Local singular asymptotic as lambda tends to zero for each fixed b>0; no global count theorem, no uniformity in b. Closely relevant January 2026 three-zone classification was not read in full and poses historical priority risk. Finite ODE runs are illustrative and do not certify infinite limits.
title: Fractional grazing onset and vanishing Floquet contraction in a three-zone Liénard flow
